archetypes.name: hook-enforcement
archetypes.rationale: The new PreToolUse hook is fail-open but deny behavior and marker matching are subtle.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the background polling guard as an integration boundary. Focus on marker discovery, fail-open behavior, stale marker handling, and whether deny decisions are scoped only to live /design waits. Check that tests cover the highest-risk false positive and false negative paths Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: design-wait-contract
archetypes.rationale: Prompt wording, wrapper markers, and reviewer status artifacts must align to stop busy-waiting.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /design immediate-background contract end to end. Check that SKILL.md directs the orchestrator to yield exactly where required, that wrappers write and clear markers at the correct lifecycle points, and that reviewer status artifacts are only terminal snapshots Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
